evidence.title: James Maynard's Oxford doctoral adviser
evidence.summary: Oxford's appointment announcement states that Maynard completed his DPhil in 2013 under Roger Heath-Brown.

sources.label: Oxford: James Maynard Regius appointment from October 2026

notes: Heath-Brown is retired/emeritus. The same announcement dates Maynard’s Regius appointment to 1 October 2026; the degree and current role are distinct facts.
